happy birthday to

Vandy

04 November

A little corner of the internet, made only for you, with all the things I never say out loud.

Dear Vandy,

Happy birthday, Vandy! I wish the best for you. You are amazing, Vandy. You deserve the best. I really feel blessed to meet you. It was magical that we became friends, and it's surreal that we've stayed friends through the years despite the distance and time. Every year I think I cannot be more grateful for you, and every year I am wrong.

Thank you for being there, Vandy, for picking up random calls, sticking by me through all the highs and lows, and being the first person I could reach in any situation. You make complex things so simple. You motivate me a lot, Vandy. I have learned a lot from you. You inspire me, Vandy. Your presence only leaves a great positive impact. I really can't imagine life any other way around. I replay our memories where we talk about friends, Buffy the Vampire Slayer, Shararat, Magic Mike, Arnav Singh Raijada, plus many, many movies, series, and books. The list is still going on with our life stories and gossip.

I hope this year gives you everything you keep quietly hoping for. Until then, I am right here, holding the cake.

With all my love, Shivani K.
